Morning Consult found that in the second quarter of 2026, 54% of registered voters in Virginia approved of the job Spanberger is doing, compared to 37% who disapproved.

Meagher said that while he cautions putting too much stock in one poll,the Morning Consult poll is good news for Spanberger, especially compared to a previous VCU poll that showed her approval rating underwater.
